oath.willpower.green: By sheer willpower I ignite the emerald flame to push back every shadow!
oath.willpower.yellow: Born of dread and golden fire, let every foe tremble before my light!
oath.willpower.blue: With unbroken hope I kindle the azure star that never fades in darkness!
oath.willpower.red: Through crimson fury and burning plasma, my rage shall consume all opposition!
oath.willpower.orange: All light, all treasure, and all power belong solely to the orange flame!
oath.willpower.indigo: Guided by deep compassion, let violet-indigo light mend what is broken!
oath.willpower.violet: Bound by radiant love, the violet crystal stands unbroken against the dark!
oath.willpower.white: Spark of pure life, shine forth and restore the spectrum of creation!
oath.willpower.black: Cold silence of the void, extinguish the living light beneath the black ring!
